Home.metaTitle: Premium real estate investment opportunities in California and Mexico | Golden State Capital Management
Home.metaDescription: Cross-border real estate syndication with curated projects, transparent reporting, and bilingual investor support across California and Mexico.
Home.heroTitle: Premium real estate investment opportunities in California and Mexico.
Home.heroSubtitle: Curated projects, bilingual investor support, and a transparent platform built for serious capital allocators.
Home.heroBullet3: Pick deals one at a time — no fund lock-ins
Home.heroBullet5: Cross-border expertise across California and Mexico
Home.statsTitle: Built on relationships, measured in numbers.
Home.whatIsBody1: Traditional real estate requires capital, connections, and time most investors don't have. Syndication pools investor funds into specific projects so you can participate without sourcing deals, qualifying for loans, or managing day-to-day operations.
Home.whatIsBody2: Each opportunity presents its project details, projected return, expected timeline, funding progress, and available supporting information. You choose projects individually while the Golden State team manages execution.
Home.whatIsBody3: Minimums start at $5,000, no operational experience is required, and each investment request is tied to a specific project.
Home.whyUsBody1: We specialize in the California–Mexico investment corridor: a cross-border focus that pairs U.S. underwriting discipline with on-the-ground execution in Baja and northern Mexico. Our deal sourcing comes from a decade of operator relationships in both jurisdictions.
Home.whyUsBody2: Investors get bilingual investor relations, a single platform with English and Spanish parity, and reporting cadence calibrated to the realities of cross-border construction and resale. We work with capital allocators who want presence in both markets without rebuilding their playbook twice.
Home.whyUsVideoCaption: Watch a 90-second explainer from our founding partners.
Home.strategiesSubtitle: Each strategy is structured for a specific risk, timeline, and outcome profile. Pick what fits your portfolio.
Home.strategyBuildToSellBody: Ground-up residential developments with a defined retail-resale exit. Profit driven by construction execution and market timing.
Home.strategyBuildToRentBody: Long-hold rental projects designed for monthly income plus appreciation. Stabilized cash flow after lease-up.
Home.strategyFliphouseBody: Short-cycle repositioning of existing homes with cosmetic or layout improvements and a quick resale exit.
Home.strategyMexToUsBody: Northbound corridor exposure: Mexican capital and operations supporting U.S.-side developments and logistics.
Home.strategyUsToMexBody: Southbound corridor exposure: U.S. capital deployed into Baja and northern Mexico developments with U.S. governance.
Home.strategyAllProjectsBody: Compare every strategy, timeline, and risk profile in one place—then dive into the type that fits your portfolio.
Home.liveSubtitle: Current projects accepting investment requests. Project details, funding progress, and projected returns are available on each project page.
Home.liveEmpty: No projects are currently open for investment requests. Check back for the next opportunity.
Home.howTitle: From signup to managing your returns.
Home.howSubtitle: Seven clear steps—from account approval and accreditation through your investment request, funding confirmation, project tracking, and returns.
Home.how1Body: Create your login, confirm your email, and complete your investor profile. Our team reviews the profile and activates approved accounts before they can begin accreditation and investment requests.
Home.how2Body: Before investing, certify that you meet the accredited-investor criteria under applicable securities laws and upload at least one supporting document. Our team reviews the submission and may request replacement documents before approval.
Home.how3Body: Review each open project's details, projected return, timeline, and remaining capacity. Enter your intended amount, choose a video call, phone call, or in-person meeting, and message our team through WhatsApp to arrange the conversation. The request does not reserve an allocation until our team approves it.
Home.how4Body: After your meeting and team approval, transfer funds using the banking instructions shared on the call or in person. Bank details are never displayed in the app or sent by email. Upload your receipt in the portal, and the investment becomes active after our team confirms the deposit.
Home.how5Body: Monitor progress from your investor dashboard: project status, completion milestones, and periodic updates. Construction and milestone photos are posted as work advances, with email notifications at key stages.
Home.how6Body: The team manages the project according to its strategy, whether that means construction and sale, repositioning and resale, or operation as a rental asset. Status changes and relevant project documents are published to investors as the project advances.
Home.how7Body: When the team records a return distribution, it appears in your returns wallet. From there, you can submit a request to cash out available funds or reinvest them in an open project; both requests remain pending until the team confirms them.
Home.howCtaBody: Create your investor account to browse open projects, begin verification, submit investment requests, and track confirmed holdings.
Home.reasonsTitle: What you get with Golden State.
Home.reason1Body: Net investor returns on completed deals have often compared favorably to our underwriting baselines. Past results do not guarantee future performance.
Home.reason2Body: Pick the projects you want exposure to. No blind-pool obligations.
Home.reason3Body: Capital is tied to a specific project's lifecycle — not a 10-year fund commitment.
Home.reason4Body: Senior partners with a decade of execution across California and Mexico real estate.
Home.reason5Body: Review project details before requesting an investment, then access progress updates and available contracts, financial reports, permits, photos, and other project documents as a holder.
Home.reason6Body: Request investments, submit deposit confirmations, track holdings and updates, and manage return requests from one investor portal.
Home.reason7Body: Use the investor experience in English or Spanish and contact the team through the same guided investment-request flow.
Home.reason8Body: California–Mexico corridor specialization with on-the-ground relationships in both jurisdictions.
Home.reason9Body: We model downside scenarios before upside. Every deal has a stress-tested base case.
Home.reason10Body: Use available wallet returns to request a cash-out or reinvestment into another open project.

About.metaTitle: Who we are | Golden State Capital Management
About.metaDescription: Learn how Golden State supports project-specific real estate investing across California and Mexico, from onboarding through portfolio reporting and returns.
About.heroTitle: We don’t just list deals—we steward capital with intent.
About.heroSubtitle: Project-specific opportunities across California and Mexico, supported by guided onboarding, bilingual investor service, and a transparent portfolio platform.
About.heroImageAlt: California skyline at dusk, representing Golden State investment markets
About.modelTitle: How our business works—in three beats.
About.modelIntro: Each investment request is tied to a specific project. The platform guides approved investors from accreditation and a conversation with our team through funding confirmation, project tracking, and return requests.
About.modelStep1Body: Compare open projects using their strategy, location, projected return, expected timeline, funding progress, and available project information.
About.modelStep2Body: After account and accreditation approval, enter an intended amount and arrange a video, phone, or in-person conversation through WhatsApp. If approved to proceed, transfer funds using instructions provided on the call or in person and upload a receipt for confirmation.
About.modelStep3Body: Confirmed contributions appear in your portfolio with project progress, updates, holder documents, and ledger-based returns. Available wallet returns can be submitted for cash-out or reinvestment, subject to team confirmation.
About.missionTitle: Why we get out of bed
About.missionQuote: Give serious investors access to project-specific real estate opportunities across California and Mexico—with the clarity we would expect for our own families.
About.missionBody: We exist to make the investor journey easier to understand: clear project information, deliberate approval steps, useful reporting, and communication that respects both your time and the risks of private real estate.
About.governanceBody: The platform does not automatically approve accounts, accreditation, investment allocations, deposits, cash-outs, or reinvestments. Our team reviews each of these steps before the corresponding status or balance is confirmed.
About.governanceBody2: That separation keeps a request distinct from an approved transaction. Investors can follow pending actions in the portal, while project holdings and wallet balances are based on confirmed ledger entries.
About.imageGovernance: Architectural detail evoking institutional governance and stewardship
About.diffTitle: What makes the investor experience different
About.diffIntro: The platform is designed for deliberate, project-by-project decisions—not instant trading or automatic allocation.
About.diff1Body: Choose which open projects to pursue and enter an intended amount for each request. There is no automatic allocation across a blind pool in the platform.
About.diff2Body: Explore project strategies connected to California and Mexico in one bilingual experience, with project-specific locations, timelines, and projected outcomes.
About.diff3Body: Portfolio values come from confirmed contributions and recorded return distributions, while status changes and newly available documents appear as investor updates.
About.investTitle: Who can invest in our projects
About.investBody: The platform is built for investors who understand that private real estate can be illiquid, concentrated, and subject to project-specific risk. Access to the investment-request flow requires account activation and accredited-investor approval.
About.investPoint1: A confirmed email, completed investor profile, and active account approved by our team.
About.investPoint2: Accredited-investor certification and at least one supporting document reviewed by our team.
About.investPoint3: A platform minimum of $5,000, except when a smaller final amount remains to complete a project's raise.
About.investNote: Account or accreditation approval does not reserve an investment. Each project request, eligibility determination, and final investment remains subject to team approval and the applicable offering documents.
About.investImageAlt: Investors reviewing opportunities with the Golden State team
About.safetyTitle: How the platform handles sensitive actions
About.safety1Body: Email verification, profile approval, authenticated sessions, and accreditation review control access to investor workflows and private documents.
About.safety2Body: Banking instructions are never displayed in the app or sent by email. They are provided during a scheduled call or in person, and investors upload a receipt for team verification.
About.safety3Body: Investment requests, deposit submissions, cash-outs, and reinvestments remain pending until reviewed. Confirmed holdings and wallet balances are calculated from active ledger records.
About.reportingBody: The investor portal brings confirmed financial records and project communications together so you can see what has been recorded and what still requires action.
About.reportingStep1Body: Receive in-app updates when a held project's status changes or when the team publishes a new batch of project documents.
About.reportingStep2Body: View confirmed invested capital, recorded returns, ledger-based ROI, project progress, expected or actual timeline, and supporting documents for each holding.
About.reportingStep3Body: Follow investment requests, deposit confirmations, cash-outs, and reinvestments from submission through team review.
About.imageReporting: Investor dashboard preview with portfolio metrics and reporting views
About.familyTitle: Built for decisions beyond a single project
About.familyBody: Private real estate moves at the pace of projects, not public markets. Our goal is to support deliberate choices with clear records, useful updates, and the ability to evaluate each new opportunity on its own terms.

FAQ.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about investing with Golden State Capital Management.
FAQ.heroSubtitle: Clear answers about account approval, accreditation, investment requests, funding confirmation, project tracking, and returns.
FAQ.intro: This FAQ explains how the platform works. It is not legal, tax, or investment advice, and definitive offering documents control each investment.
FAQ.highlight1Body: Accounts, accreditation, deposits, cash-outs, and reinvestments require team review before confirmation.
FAQ.highlight2Body: Review open projects individually and submit an intended amount for the opportunity you want to pursue.
FAQ.highlight3Body: Holdings, returns, and wallet balances are calculated from confirmed ledger entries.
FAQ.item1Answer: To enter the investment-request flow, you need a confirmed email, a completed investor profile, an active account approved by our team, and approved accredited-investor status. Final eligibility for any investment is governed by its offering documents and team approval.
FAQ.item2Answer: You can browse public project pages and compare strategy, location, projected return, timeline, funding progress, and remaining capacity. The platform minimum is $5,000, except when a smaller final amount remains to complete a project's raise. An approved account and accreditation are required to submit an investment request.
FAQ.item3Question: What should I expect after I invest?
FAQ.item3Answer: After your deposit is confirmed, the holding appears in your portfolio. You can view invested capital, recorded returns, ledger-based ROI, project progress and timeline, holder documents, and in-app updates when the project's status changes or new documents are published.
FAQ.item4Answer: No. Real estate carries risk, including loss of principal. Any projections are illustrative and not guarantees of performance.
FAQ.item5Question: How do I contact the team?
FAQ.item5Answer: Use the contact form or the phone and email listed in the footer. We respond as quickly as we can during business hours.
FAQ.item6Answer: The website and portal do not establish or summarize your liability protections. Ownership structure, investor rights, transfer restrictions, liability limits, and other legal terms are governed by the definitive documents for the specific offering. Review those documents and consult your own legal advisor before investing.
FAQ.item7Question: What happens if a project is delayed or over budget?
FAQ.item7Answer: Delays and cost pressure can occur and may affect timing or returns. The team can update project status and progress and publish supporting documents for confirmed holders, but the platform cannot prevent or guarantee a particular response to project risk. The applicable offering documents govern what happens in a delay or default.
FAQ.item8Answer: The portal does not currently generate tax forms automatically. Any tax documents, their timing, and their delivery method depend on the investment structure and applicable requirements. Confirm the process with our team and consult your own tax advisor.
FAQ.item9Answer: Before submitting an investment request, you must certify that you meet the accredited-investor criteria under applicable securities laws and upload at least one supporting document. Our team reviews the submission and may request replacement documents. Platform approval is not a legal opinion or a determination by a regulator.
FAQ.item10Question: Can I schedule a call before investing?
FAQ.item10Answer: You can contact the team before investing. In the investment flow, approved investors enter an intended amount and choose a video call, phone call, or in-person meeting, then message the team through WhatsApp. Creating the request or opening WhatsApp does not schedule or confirm a meeting by itself.
FAQ.item11Question: How do you handle transparency during the life of a project?
FAQ.item11Answer: Confirmed holders receive in-app notifications when the team records a project-status change or publishes a new batch of project documents. The portfolio also displays current progress, timeline, invested amount, recorded returns, and ROI. The platform does not promise a fixed quarterly update cadence.
FAQ.item12Question: How does an investment request become an active holding?
FAQ.item12Answer: After account and accreditation approval, enter an intended amount and contact the team through the guided WhatsApp flow. If the team approves you to proceed, use the banking instructions shared on the call or in person, then upload a transfer receipt. The investment becomes an active portfolio holding only after the team confirms the deposit.
FAQ.bottomCtaBody: Contact the team with questions about onboarding, accreditation, investment requests, or the documents that govern a specific opportunity.
